answer_1.quote: ...We utilized three of the most powerful closed‑source LLMs ... Each LLM generated three reviews using prompts that included the ICLR review guidelines...
answer_1.outputs: textual peer reviews (including summary, strengths, weaknesses, writing assessment, and recommendation score)

answer_2.quote: ...We compute the F1 on each paper then average across papers... We also report BERTScore, ROUGE, and the novel ITF‑IDF diversity metric...

answer_3.quote: ...we assess if prompting popular LLMs (both closed‑and open‑source) can solve this problem... We employ two prompting strategies: Labeling‑All and Select‑Deficient...

answer_4.quote: ...The annotation was conducted on both human‑written and LLM‑generated reviews... annotators were asked to label each sentence (a) whether it is Deficient, and (b) provide an explanation if it is...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators read the paper, all reviews, meta‑reviews, and rebuttals, then for each review sentence decide if it is Deficient and write an explanation.
